spec.kitLine: FB enter, all allies: Hit Rate 20.09%
spec.assertion: buffApply hitRatePct=20.09 to all 4 roster slugs, once per fullBurstStart; plus a functional drop test (base drake total > run with the effect stripped). Fails under self-scope / SG-scope nearest-wrongs (recipient set shrinks) and under burstCast keying (fires only on drake's own rotations, count < FBs x 4). Magnitude of the hit-rate to core lift is NOT asserted (measurement-gated).

Recipient set equals the full roster and every teammate loses damage when the effect is stripped AND when the block is retargeted to self. durationShots undefined + finite expiresFrame kills the 'for N rounds' duration-semantics nearest-wrong; maxStacks 1 kills a stacking encoding.

Recipients of 63.88 include drake and are a STRICT subset of the all-allies branch's recipients; the retarget-to-allies counterfactual shows the same effect reaching the whole roster, proving the weapon filter is authored and not an engine no-op. Fails if encoded as plain allies (sets become equal) or dropped entirely (drake missing).

spec.kitLine: FB enter, SG allies: Max Ammo 50.14%
spec.assertion: Same subset/scope proof on stat maxAmmoPct, plus the weapon-state-is-damage check: stripping both ammo buffs strictly lowers total shot events and drake's total damage. Fails under the 'ammo is defensive, skip it' nearest-wrong (delta would be zero).

Isolated by a 3-run subtraction (base / only-the-10-block / neither), so the proc count and damage are attributable to drake with no per-unit event attribution. Proc ratio 5-block:10-block must sit in [1.6,2.4] and the damage ratio in [2.8,5.8] — the swapped-magnitude nearest-wrong lands at ~0.98.

Same subtraction pair; additionally, cutting drake's shot count (ammo buffs removed) must cut the skill2 proc count — this is the discriminator against an interval trigger, which would emit the same count in a fixed 180 s fight. Ratio-based so it is robust to whether the engine counts rounds or pellets (a flagged unknown for a 10-pellet SG).
it.skip — v1 fixture has a single partless boss, so neither the 3-target fan-out nor the lowest-remaining-HP ordering is observable. Damage is asserted as a single hit per proc.

Count of burst-slot damage events removed by stripping the flatDamage equals the number of drake burst casts (read off her self-buff applies). Fails under a fullBurstEnter keying, which over-fires in this two-B3 fixture (helm also completes chains). A second assertion requires every removed hit to carry inFullBurst===false — burst-cast damage lands before the FB window opens, so an in-FB encoding would wrongly collect the +50% major.
Recipients === {drake}, one apply per drake burst, casterIdx===targetIdx. Functional half is covered by the shared ammo-strip run (fewer shots, less damage), so the line is not merely event-visible.

Recipients === {drake} and durationShots undefined; the retarget-to-allies run proves the self scope is authored (teammates DO receive it there). Inertness: with the buff stripped, every teammate's total is byte-identical while drake's strictly drops — kills an allies-scoped or damageTaken-debuff mis-encoding.
it.skip — single-boss fixture cannot discriminate range-scoped AoE fan-out from a single hit.

fixtures: controlComp('drake', true) for every run (liter B1 / crown B2 / drake B3 carry / helm B3). helm is KEPT deliberately: it supplies a second Burst III so a burstCast-keyed line can be discriminated from a fullBurstEnter-keyed one (they would be indistinguishable if drake were the only B3), and liter+crown are mandatory because a lone B3 makes zero Full Bursts, which would make the entire skill1 block vacuous. All three teammates are non-SG, which is what makes the Shotgun-scope branch observable. 11 hoisted 180 s runs: base + 10 single-fact counterfactuals built with withPatchedOverride (retarget skill1-team to self; retarget skill1-SG to allies; drop team ATK; drop hit rate; drop BOTH maxAmmo buffs; drop the 201.6 rider; drop both skill2 riders; drop the 3009.6 nuke; retarget the burst self-buff to allies; drop attackDamagePct). Damage attribution is done by subtracting event counts/totals between paired runs rather than by reading a slug off damage events, so no guessed event field is load-bearing.
gaps: skill2 'Affects 3 enemy unit(s) with the lowest remaining HP' — single partless boss in v1; the 3-target spread and the HP ordering are unobservable (it.skip).
burst 'Affects enemies within attack range' — AoE spread indistinguishable from a single hit against one boss (it.skip).
skill1 Hit Rate 20.09% → core-rate magnitude — the hit-rate-to-core conversion is a derived, measurement-gated model; only presence and direction are asserted (it.skip on the magnitude).

FLAG (not skipped): whether the skill2 'normal attack' counter ticks per ROUND or per PELLET is not knowable from the prose for a 10-pellet SG; every skill2 assertion is written as a ratio so it holds under either reading, but the absolute proc cadence is unpinned.
FLAG: cadence (pullsPerSec) and reloadFrames 111 come from datamine fields flagged unreliable; no assertion depends on an absolute shot count, only on directional shot-count deltas.
